dossier_meta.statement_text: For any partition $E_1, E_2, \ldots, E_m$ of $E(K_{n,n})$ and any $j \leq m$ there exists a perfect matching $F$ in $K_{n,n}$ satisfying $|F \cap E_i| \geq \left\lfloor \frac{|E_i|}{n} \right\rfloor$ for all $i \neq j$, and $|F \cap E_j| \geq \left\lfloor \frac{|E_j|}{n} \right\rfloor - 1$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Central conjecture of the paper: the matching complex of $K_{n,n}$ admits almost fair representation of any partition of its edge set. The paper proves the conjecture for $m = 2$ and $m = 3$ (Theorem 1.10) using topological methods including Sperner's lemma.
